why: receive WITH the end-to-end integrity verdict attached (`rclc_integrity_status_t`: sequence gap, duplicate, CRC valid/mismatch/absent). RFC-0028. ROS 2 has no counterpart because a desktop DDS link is not treated as a safety channel. Renamed from `nros_subscription_try_recv_validated` by phase-379 W6 decision 1 (2026-09-03). Renamed from `nros_subscription_take_validated` by phase-487 W1, when the polled subscription became its own type, `rclc_polling_subscription_t`: a subscription the executor dispatches keeps its subscriber in the executor arena, a polled one keeps it in the struct, and one type holding both meant every dispatched subscription carried storage only the polled road fills.
